summary: Master pension fund portfolio management. Learn ALM, LDI strategies, and ESG integration to secure long-term fund solvency. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Pension fund portfolio management aligns institutional retirement assets with long-term liabilities while balancing investment risk and growth. It is relevant to investment officers, trustees, analysts and portfolio managers responsible for these assets, and covers setting strategic allocations, matching liabilities with fixed-income hedges, and assessing risk and performance. Participants also work on investment policy statements, stress testing, alternative assets and ESG integration.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically designed for professionals responsible for the stewardship, analysis, and execution of institutional retirement assets.
prerequisites: Participants should have a minimum of 3-5 years of experience in finance, investment, or actuarial roles. A working knowledge of basic statistics and Excel is required for the modeling exercises. No prior programming or coding knowledge is necessary, as all technical exercises will utilize provided templates and standard financial software.
